minutes.headline: Committee approved routine year-end transfers, heard the middle-high principal made permanent, and took in climate and civics reports.
minutes.summary: The School Committee approved prior minutes, a set of end-of-year line item transfers, and a Keystone Collaborative quarterly update, all by roll call. The superintendent announced a permanent principal for the combined middle-high school, and staff presented on school climate surveys, an intro to law course, civics requirements, and athletics. The committee also discussed an equity workshop and the finance committee's budget hearings, with no budget figures decided.

An equity goal discussion will be added as a future agenda item, with Mr. Leighton's policy example circulated via the superintendent; MASC workshop deferred.
The May 4 meeting stays on the calendar since a quorum is available; agenda to be minimal.

what_happened.line: The Committee approved a set of end-of-year line item transfers by roll call, with all five members heard voting yes.
The superintendent made Mr. Santry the permanent principal of the combined middle-high school, with three assistant principals and a facilities director position to be posted.
The Committee accepted the Keystone Collaborative quarterly update by roll call, all five members heard voting yes.
The budget update planned for May 4 will instead be given to the committee on April 27.
A finance committee concern about the capital plan cost of primary school air conditioning was raised; the superintendent said an engineer peer review is coming before Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: The transfers move money between lines to close out the year, drawn from unspent salary and tuition lines, so they show where this year's budget came in under and over.
Primary school air conditioning is a capital cost that may reach Town Meeting, where residents would be asked to vote on it, and the committee said an engineer's review will come first.
watch_next: April 27, 2022: the budget update to the committee, moved up from May 4.
The engineer peer review of primary school air conditioning, expected before Town Meeting.
